method: Independent copied PhysX-cooked convex robot solids at one actual recorded startup/named-Home configuration against the unchanged existing declared V4 fixture boxes; all 11 robot bodies, 55 body-box pairs in total.
interpretation: Counterfactual final-fixture goal geometry, not observed contact: fixtures were parked away at startup. Zero solid distance cannot distinguish touching from overlap. This is not route validation or a continuous-safety guarantee.
